**Slides.** [Open the deck at Part 2](../../live/day.html#/part-2-the-estimand-and-the-causal-graph){target="_blank"} in its own tab, or follow it on the [slides page](../day/slides.qmd).

In this stage you write the estimand statement behind the claim, finish the causal graph of the experiment, and reproduce the value recorded in the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026) for one of the five analysts, whichever you choose. It takes nearly six hours.

## 1. The exercise

[Read the exercise page](exercise.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

## 2. The claim and its estimand

**On the slides**, from [the question of the paper](../../live/day.html#/the-question-of-the-paper){target="_blank"}, at the end of Part 1, to the end of Part 2.

## 3. Task 2 – The data, the estimand and the graph

**In your report**, in the two boxes of Task 2 of `index.qmd`, or in your working script. Count what came back for each name, complete the estimand statement, and put the questions of the second box to the causal graph of `R/dag_starter.R`.

[Open the deck at Task 2](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-2-meet-the-emails-draw-the-graph){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 2](../../lab.qmd#task-2-data){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## 4. Task 3 – The reproduction

**On the slides, then in your report**, in Task 3 of `index.qmd`. The slides read the instruction of Task 2 of the robustness study word for word. Then choose one of the five analysts and reproduce the analysis in the tab of that analyst. Working alone, you can take a second analyst whose test differs from the first.

[Open the deck at Part 3](../../live/day.html#/part-3-the-reproduction){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 3](../../lab.qmd#task-3-reproduction){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## 5. The continuity correction

**On the slides**, at [the continuity correction](../../live/day.html#/the-continuity-correction){target="_blank"} and the three slides after it, two of which run both tests without the correction.

## 6. Audit experiments

[Open Audit experiments](../../companion/experiments.qmd#sec-audits){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work from [Audit and correspondence studies](../../companion/experiments.qmd#sec-audits) to [Comparing among replies](../../companion/experiments.qmd#sec-posttreatment). The tasks do not need section 3, which simulates the experiment with DeclareDesign, or the second simulation in section 5, and you can leave both until the route is done.
